g.text: Closing stock of closed, open, and mangrove forest as a share of official regional land area
Forest data: PSA Land Asset Accounts 2015-2020 / CPES Table 1.22 (2020). Denominators: official regional land areas (PSA, 2013 DENR-LMB master list).
Caution: these regional land areas sum to 34.77M ha, about 17% more than PSA's national land-cover total of 29,588,367 ha, so regional percentages
are conservative and are not directly comparable with the national figure. Boundaries: geoBoundaries gbOpen PHL ADM1, 2020 vintage (NAMRIA, PSA, OCHA
